title: Shared iPad for Frontline Teams — Managed Apple IDs, ABM & Microsoft 365 Session Isolation
author_notes: Built from a live engagement: ~40 shift-based Facilities-Management field iPads where M365 sessions were not clearing between users (next user saw the prior user's mail). NET-NEW: Apple Shared iPad (the Apple multi-user feature: Managed Apple IDs + per-user APFS data separation) — the catalog had 0 Shared-iPad / 0 Managed-Apple-ID coverage. GAP-DEDUPED: cross-references (does NOT duplicate) 'Implement iOS Lock Down Profile … for Shared Devices' (iPhone single-user lockdown), 'iOS iPhone Shared Device Mode (Lockdown) with WebEx Calling' (Microsoft app-level SDM on iPhone), and 'Implement Entra ID Integration with ABM for Account Auto Provisioning' (ABM account provisioning). Automation = PowerShell (Microsoft.Graph Intune) — read-only discovery/validate/report + one -WhatIf-gated restriction-assignment helper. Apple Shared iPad prerequisites (iPadOS version, supervision, storage/per-user partition sizing), Managed Apple ID federation specifics, Apple domain-capture/conflict-resolution process, and the Microsoft 365 Shared Device Mode iOS app-support list are ALL flagged 'verify against current Apple/Microsoft guidance' — never asserted. Reclaiming staff personal Apple IDs is an identity/HR/comms decision deferred to the customer.
